Intuit's Consumer Group is committed to building tools and services that improve our members' financial journeys. At the heart of this mission, the Credit Karma Engagement team builds in-product features and experiences that help members take meaningful action to improve their financial outcomes, from building credit, to saving money, to paying down debt.

The team is seeking a Staff Data Scientist to serve as an analytical partner to our Subscriptions product team, responsible for using data to improve the member experience across the subscription lifecycle, from trial and conversion through renewal and retention. This is a high-impact role where you will bring scientific rigor to product decisions, partner closely with Product and Engineering, and help shape how we measure and grow subscription value for our members.

Responsibilities
Drive analytics strategy for Subscriptions: Own the analytics agenda for the Subscriptions product area, mapping the member journey end to end, from trial and onboarding through conversion, renewal, and cancellation, to identify the highest-leverage opportunities. Partner with product leadership: Combine data insights with business acumen to partner with Product, Engineering, and Design leaders in shaping roadmap and prioritization decisions. Apply advanced analytical methods: Apply ML and causal inference techniques to subscriptions-specific problems such as churn prediction, renewal optimization, and pricing or packaging experiments, adapting existing frameworks or building new ones as needed. Design and run experiments: Design and execute experiments (A/B/n, and quasi-experimental designs where testing is constrained) to evaluate changes to the member experience and quantify their impact on member and business outcomes. Build member segmentation: Analyze member behavior within Subscriptions to build segmentation that improves targeting, personalization, and offer strategy. Contribute to the AI-native roadmap: Partner with the team to identify opportunities to apply AI/ML within the subscriptions experience, help design measurement plans, and connect model performance to member and business outcomes. Mentor and support the team: Mentor other data scientists on best practices and experimentation rigor, and contribute to hiring and calibration as needed.
Qualifications
We're looking for a curious, proactive data scientist with a passion for driving member engagement and retention.

7+ years of experience in data science and analytics, with a track record of driving impact within a product area or initiative; experience with subscription, membership, or lifecycle-based products strongly preferred, fintech experience a plus. Ability to translate ambiguous product questions into structured analyses and actionable recommendations. Experience designing and interpreting experiments, with working knowledge of causal inference techniques for use when experimentation is constrained. Solid understanding of customer segmentation and experimentation design, with the judgment to balance statistical rigor and business considerations. Exposure to lightweight Machine Learning in terms of being able to build offline classification & regression models to inform business decisions. Experience contributing to reusable analytical frameworks, methodologies, or tools used by others on the team. Strong communication and stakeholder-influence skills, with the ability to work effectively with Director-level partners across business and technical teams. Ability to navigate ambiguity, make fast data-driven decisions, and operate effectively in a fast-paced, dynamic environment. Ability to use AI-native tools to plan, implement, and synthesize analyses across use cases ranging from experiment readouts to retention/churn deep dives. BS or MS in Statistics, Mathematics, Operations Research, Computer Science, Engineering, Econometrics, or a related field.

Additionally, the position at this level requires effective leadership and project management skills as well as in-depth knowledge in quantitative analytical methods, data management, visualization, and programming skills suitable to drive data-driven decisions.

+ Mentors and guides junior risk data scientists
+ Plans and manages multiple concurrent projects

Why UKG:
At UKG, the work you do matters. The code you ship, the decisions you make, and the care you show a customer all add up to real impact. Today, tens of millions of workers start and end their days with our workforce operating platform. Helping people get paid, grow in their careers, and shape the future of their industries. That’s what we do.
We never stop learning. We never stop challenging the norm. We push for better, and we celebrate the wins along the way. Here, you’ll get flexibility that’s real, benefits you can count on, and a team that succeeds together. Because at UKG, your work matters—and so do you.
About the team
Our Go-to-Market Data Science team turns UKG workforce data into insights that help customers and business leaders understand their workforce. We develop benchmarks, conduct applied research, and partner with economists, Communications, Product, and Engineering to connect what happens in the flow of work with broader labor market trends.
About the role
We are seeking a Principal Larbor Market Data Scientist to lead hands-on research and analysis focused on labor and workforce insights. As a senior individual contributor, you will own work from defining the question and investigating the data through validating findings and explaining their significance to business leaders.
This role is dedicated to supporting UKG senior leaders, Corporate Communications, and our labor economists with evidence for executive-to-executive discussions, media interviews, press releases, and thought leadership. Working closely with our economist colleagues, you will combine UKG workforce data with external labor market sources to develop timely insights that inform executive discussions and external communications. You will bring the technical depth to build the analysis and the judgment to determine what the evidence supports.
Responsibilities
+ Partner with labor economists and Communications to define research questions and produce validated analyses, charts, and supporting materials for executive briefings, customer discussions, and media preparation.
+ Lead original research on hiring, separations, hours worked, wages, labor supply, and other workforce trends. Identify questions that matter to employers and workers, and investigate changes across industries, geographies, and workforce segments.
+ Deliver executive briefings, charts, talking points, and supporting analysis for customer discussions and media engagements.
+ Excellent written and verbal communication, with experience translating quantitative findings into concise, accurate materials for leaders, business audiences, or public use.
+ Own the analytical response to urgent executive and media questions. Clarify the question, assess feasibility, and deliver findings with the context and limitations needed to use them accurately.
+ Combine large-scale UKG workforce data with public and commercial labor data. Evaluate source definitions, coverage, reporting lags, and comparability before drawing conclusions.
+ Develop and validate statistical methods for workforce indicators, trends, and comparisons. Address seasonality, changing employer populations, missing data, revisions, and sampling bias; distinguish workforce changes from data artifacts and association from causation.
+ Build reproducible analysis and recurring reporting workflows using SQL and Python. Maintain documented methods, versioned code, and automated checks so results can be reproduced, reviewed, and updated efficiently.
+ Review the numerical accuracy and interpretation of findings, charts, and proposed public claims. Explain uncertainty, challenge unsupported conclusions, and recommend when findings need further analysis before use.
+ Partner with Product, Engineering, and data owners to resolve source issues and improve the datasets supporting workforce insights. Apply appropriate privacy protections and aggregation standards in collaboration with Legal and privacy teams.
+ Provide technical leadership and mentor data scientists through research design, code review, and stakeholder discussions. Lead substantial workstreams independently and communicate priorities, tradeoffs, and delivery risks clearly.
Basic qualifications
+ Bachelor’s degree or higher in statistics, data science, economics, computer science, mathematics, or a related quantitative field.
+ 8+ years of relevant experience in data science, applied statistics, quantitative research, or a related field, with demonstrated ownership of complex analytical work and influence at a senior level.
+ Substantial hands-on experience analyzing labor market or workforce data in recent professional roles, including producing research, indicators, or insights from employment, payroll, wage, hours, job posting, or worker-level datasets.
+ Deep applied statistical expertise, including time-series analysis, sampling and weighting, hypothesis testing, and uncertainty estimation. Ability to select methods appropriate to the data and question.
+ Strong SQL and Python skills, including the ability to work independently with large, complex datasets and build maintainable, reproducible analytical workflows.
+ Demonstrated ability to assess data quality and representativeness, reconcile inconsistent sources, and explain how methodological choices affect conclusions.
+ Ability to explain analytical findings, methods, and limitations clearly to technical and nontechnical colleagues and collaborate on materials for business audiences.
+ Ability to lead ambiguous research assignments independently, collaborate with economists and technical partners, and deliver sound analysis under time-sensitive conditions.
Preferred qualifications
+ Master’s or PhD in a relevant quantitative discipline.
+ Recent experience developing labor market research, indicators, or data products at a statistical agency, payroll provider, workforce analytics organization, or comparable research institution.
+ Experience supporting corporate communications, economic publications, executive briefings, or media preparation, including reviewing research for public release.
+ Experience with econometrics, forecasting, or causal inference applied to labor and workforce questions.
+ Experience with Google Cloud Platform and BigQuery, workforce management or human capital management data, and recurring labor market indicators or benchmark publications.

# **Position Overview**

At PNC, our people are our greatest differentiator and competitive advantage in the markets we serve. We are all united in delivering the best experience for our customers. We work together each day to foster an inclusive workplace culture where all of our employees feel respected, valued and have an opportunity to contribute to the company’s success. As a Data Scientist Senior within PNC's Internal Audit organization, you will be based in Cleveland, OH; Pittsburgh, PA; Raleigh, NC or Birmingham, AL.  
  
PNC's Internal Audit organization is seeking a highly motivated Senior Data Scientist to join a dynamic team that is redefining how risk is identified, monitored, and assessed across the enterprise.  
PNC's Internal Audit department is composed of industry leaders who provide independent, objective assurance and consulting services designed to add value and improve organizational performance. Through innovative use of data, emerging technologies, and analytical methodologies, the team is evolving audit practices to deliver deeper insights, proactive risk identification, and more effective assurance.  
  
As a Senior Data Scientist, you will play a key role in delivering advanced analytical solutions that enhance audit effectiveness, improve operational insights, and support strategic decision-making across Internal Audit. You will collaborate with audit professionals, business partners, and technology teams to develop scalable, production-ready analytics and AI-enabled solutions that help identify risk and drive value.  
  
The successful candidate will be a technically strong and innovative data scientist who can combine advanced analytical techniques with business acumen to solve complex risk challenges. This individual will help Internal Audit move beyond descriptive reporting toward predictive and AI-enabled insights that improve audit quality, strengthen risk identification, and drive strategic value across the organization.  
  
Key Responsibilities  
• Lead the design, development, testing, deployment, and maintenance of advanced analytics, machine learning, and AI-enabled solutions supporting Internal Audit priorities.  
• Partner with audit teams and stakeholders to translate business challenges, audit objectives, and risk considerations into analytical solutions and data products.  
• Develop predictive, diagnostic, anomaly detection, and risk-focused models that improve audit planning, testing, continuous monitoring, and reporting capabilities.  
• Build scalable, maintainable, and reusable analytical frameworks, workflows, and data products that drive efficiency and insight generation across the audit lifecycle.  
• Identify opportunities to leverage automation, machine learning, and generative AI technologies to enhance audit processes and risk identification.  
• Collaborate with technology, data, and enterprise partners to support model deployment, productionization, data pipeline development, and ongoing solution maintenance.  
• Ensure analytical solutions comply with established governance, validation, testing, documentation, and lifecycle management standards.  
• Communicate analytical results and strategic recommendations to both technical and non-technical audiences, translating complex findings into actionable business insights.  
• Mentor and provide technical guidance to team members while promoting best practices in data science, machine learning, software development, and analytics engineering.  
• Contribute to the evolution of Internal Audit's data science, automation, and AI capabilities through innovation, thought leadership, and continuous improvement initiatives.  
  
Desired Skills & Experience  
Technical Skills  
• Advanced proficiency in Python and SQL.  
• Experience with data manipulation and analytical libraries such as Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn, PySpark, TensorFlow, or similar technologies.  
• Experience working with large-scale data environments, including Hadoop-based platforms, distributed data processing frameworks, and enterprise data ecosystems.  
• Experience using GitHub or other source control platforms for code management, collaboration, version control, and code review.  
• Experience with machine learning, statistical modeling, predictive analytics, and data science methodologies.  
• Experience with natural language processing (NLP), text analytics, document intelligence, topic modeling, and analysis of unstructured data.  
• Experience developing, validating, deploying, and monitoring production analytics or machine learning solutions.  
• Familiarity with software package, dependency, and artifact management tools such as Artifactory, Conda, pip, or similar enterprise development technologies.  
• Familiarity with data visualization platforms such as Power BI, Tableau, or similar tools.  
Emerging Technology Skills  
• Experience with generative AI, large language models (LLMs), prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), AI agents, or related technologies preferred.  
• Understanding of AI governance, model risk management, and responsible AI practices preferred.  
Leadership & Business Skills  
• Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking capabilities.  
• Ability to influence stakeholders and communicate effectively across technical and business audiences.  
• Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver high-quality solutions in a dynamic environment.  
• Strong collaboration skills and a passion for mentoring and developing others.

OR

description.value: Position Overview At PNC, our people are our greatest differentiator and competitive advantage in the markets we serve. We are all united in delivering the best experience for our customers. We work together each day to foster an inclusive workplace culture where all of our employees feel respected, valued and have an opportunity to contribute to the company’s success. As a Data Scientist Senior within PNC's Internal Audit organization, you will be based in Cleveland, OH; Pittsburgh, PA; Raleigh, NC or Birmingham, AL. PNC's Internal Audit organization is seeking a highly motivated Senior Data Scientist to join a dynamic team that is redefining how risk is identified, monitored, and assessed across the enterprise. PNC's Internal Audit department is composed of industry leaders who provide independent, objective assurance and consulting services designed to add value and improve organizational performance. Through innovative use of data, emerging technologies, and analytical methodologies, the team is evolving audit practices to deliver deeper insights, proactive risk identification, and more effective assurance. As a Senior Data Scientist, you will play a key role in delivering advanced analytical solutions that enhance audit effectiveness, improve operational insights, and support strategic decision-making across Internal Audit. You will collaborate with audit professionals, business partners, and technology teams to develop scalable, production-ready analytics and AI-enabled solutions that help identify risk and drive value. The successful candidate will be a technically strong and innovative data scientist who can combine advanced analytical techniques with business acumen to solve complex risk challenges. This individual will help Internal Audit move beyond descriptive reporting toward predictive and AI-enabled insights that improve audit quality, strengthen risk identification, and drive strategic value across the organization. Key Responsibilities • Lead the design, development, testing, deployment, and maintenance of advanced analytics, machine learning, and AI-enabled solutions supporting Internal Audit priorities. • Partner with audit teams and stakeholders to translate business challenges, audit objectives, and risk considerations into analytical solutions and data products. • Develop predictive, diagnostic, anomaly detection, and risk-focused models that improve audit planning, testing, continuous monitoring, and reporting capabilities. • Build scalable, maintainable, and reusable analytical frameworks, workflows, and data products that drive efficiency and insight generation across the audit lifecycle. • Identify opportunities to leverage automation, machine learning, and generative AI technologies to enhance audit processes and risk identification. • Collaborate with technology, data, and enterprise partners to support model deployment, productionization, data pipeline development, and ongoing solution maintenance. • Ensure analytical solutions comply with established governance, validation, testing, documentation, and lifecycle management standards. • Communicate analytical results and strategic recommendations to both technical and non-technical audiences, translating complex findings into actionable business insights. • Mentor and provide technical guidance to team members while promoting best practices in data science, machine learning, software development, and analytics engineering. • Contribute to the evolution of Internal Audit's data science, automation, and AI capabilities through innovation, thought leadership, and continuous improvement initiatives. Desired Skills & Experience Technical Skills • Advanced proficiency in Python and SQL. • Experience with data manipulation and analytical libraries such as Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn, PySpark, TensorFlow, or similar technologies. • Experience working with large-scale data environments, including Hadoop-based platforms, distributed data processing frameworks, and enterprise data ecosystems. • Experience using GitHub or other source control platforms for code management, collaboration, version control, and code review. • Experience with machine learning, statistical modeling, predictive analytics, and data science methodologies. • Experience with natural language processing (NLP), text analytics, document intelligence, topic modeling, and analysis of unstructured data. • Experience developing, validating, deploying, and monitoring production analytics or machine learning solutions. • Familiarity with software package, dependency, and artifact management tools such as Artifactory, Conda, pip, or similar enterprise development technologies. • Familiarity with data visualization platforms such as Power BI, Tableau, or similar tools. Emerging Technology Skills • Experience with generative AI, large language models (LLMs), prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), AI agents, or related technologies preferred. • Understanding of AI governance, model risk management, and responsible AI practices preferred. Leadership & Business Skills • Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking capabilities. • Ability to influence stakeholders and communicate effectively across technical and business audiences. • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver high-quality solutions in a dynamic environment. • Strong collaboration skills and a passion for mentoring and developing others. PNC is an in-office company that fosters a supportive culture where employees can thrive and achieve balance. We encourage candidates to connect with their recruiter and hiring manager to understand workplace expectations and ensure the role aligns with their goals. PNC will not provide sponsorship for employment visas or participate in STEM OPT for this position. Directs the data gathering, data processing and data mining of large and complex datasets. Leads the development of algorithms using advanced mathematical and statistical techniques like machine learning to predict business outcomes and recommend optimal actions to management. Leads analytical experiments in a methodical manner to find opportunities for product and process optimization. Presents business insights to management using visualization technologies and data storytelling. Partners with Data Architects, Data Analysts, Data Engineers and Visualization Experts to develop data-driven solutions for the business. PNC Employees take pride in our reputation and to continue building upon that we expect our employees to be: Customer Focused - Knowledgeable of the values and practices that align customer needs and satisfaction as primary considerations in all business decisions and able to leverage that information in creating customized customer solutions. Managing Risk - Assessing and effectively managing all of the risks associated with their business objectives and activities to ensure they adhere to and support PNC's Enterprise Risk Management Framework. about sciemo

Sciemo builds AI for consumer goods: technology that helps businesses make faster, smarter, and more human decisions across the entire IBP process. From optimizing promotions to balancing demand and supply, Sciemo's platform transforms messy, siloed data into measurable business impact. Its AI agents assist decision-makers in real-time, turning complexity into clarity. We are headquartered in New York City.

ROLE

As a Data Scientist, you will build the models that turn customer data into decisions — forecasting, optimization, measurement, and the analysis that tells us whether any of it is working.

You'll work across the full lifecycle: understanding a business problem, exploring the data, developing and validating models, and partnering with engineers to get them into production. You'll also work directly with customer data and customer-facing teams, which means your analysis needs to hold up under scrutiny from people whose decisions depend on it.

This role is a strong fit for someone earlier in their career who wants real ownership quickly. You'll get direct mentorship from our Co-Founder & CAIO and senior engineers, and the scope to grow fast.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Modeling & Analysis

• Develop, validate, and iterate on models for forecasting, optimization, anomaly detection, and measurement.

• Perform exploratory analysis on complex customer datasets to surface patterns worth acting on.

• Design and analyze experiments; build the measurement approaches that quantify business impact.

• Establish rigorous validation practices — backtesting, holdouts, and honest error analysis.

Production & Collaboration

• Partner with ML and data engineers to move models from notebook to production.

• Contribute to feature engineering, evaluation pipelines, and model monitoring.

• Write clean, reproducible Python that other people can read and build on.

Business Impact

• Translate business questions into analytical problems, and analytical results back into recommendations.

• Communicate findings clearly to internal teams and customers, including non-technical audiences.

• Follow deployed models into the real world and help make sure they're delivering what we promised.

ALL ABOUT YOU

• Experience developing and validating models on real, messy data — through internships, prior roles, or substantive project work.

• Solid foundation in statistics and machine learning: regression, time series, tree-based methods, experimental design.

• Strong Python (pandas, scikit-learn, and the surrounding ecosystem) and strong SQL.

• Curiosity about the business problem behind the data, not just the modeling technique.

• Clear communication — you can explain what you did, why, and what it means, to someone who doesn't do this for a living.

• Strong problem-solving skills, adaptability, and a "hacker" mentality.

• Eagerness to learn quickly in a startup environment.

Nice to have

• Exposure to CPG, retail, or consumer brand data.

• Experience with Spark, cloud platforms (AWS or similar), or orchestration tools.

• Familiarity with LLMs and their practical use in analytical workflows.

BENEFITS & PERKS

Hybrid role based in New York City; open to remote U.S. candidates willing to travel monthly to our NYC office.
